metadata.description: Global alternative asset manager founded in 2004, managing $1.5 billion across venture capital and debt. Pioneers of Venture Capital as a Service.
We turn exceptional individuals into funded founders. We back you first, then give you a bridge to Silicon Valley.

Blackbird is an Australasian investment firm whose mission is to invest in wild hearts, with the wildest ideas, right from the beginning. We have a portfolio of over 100 of Australia and New Zealand's most ambitious companies, valued at over 10B. We are just getting started.
